description: Which store-shard test files the Postgres leg (lane server-store-pg) runs [POD-6980, POD-6958 design 2.10].
The leg runs every file of the store shard (test-shards.json) except the two lists below.
sqliteOnly: the file's subject is SQLite itself. Each entry says why. It never runs on Postgres.

pending: the file is meant to run on both engines but does not pass on Postgres yet. A task that makes a file pass on Postgres removes it here; the list is empty when the Postgres store is complete (POD-6994). PODIUM_TEST_STORE_PG_LEG=pending runs only these files, to see which pass now.
Paths are relative to the repository root. src/store/test-store-engines.test.ts checks that every entry is a store-shard file and that no file is in both lists.
beyondStoreShard: a file outside the store shard that also runs on the Postgres leg (a boot-wiring file, a server started on a Postgres URL). Each entry says why [POD-6994].

sqliteOnly.apps/server/src/identity/ensure-local-id: Tests the one-time upgrade of a self-hosted install's legacy members, passwords and invitations into the identity tables; a Postgres install has no legacy identity rows and builds no local accounts (design 2.9).
Runs the identity suite on its SQLite schema; the identity package tests its Postgres twin itself.

beyondStoreShard.apps/server/src/router.setup.test.ts: A lean-gate boot-wiring file: the server router's construction and required wiring over a store, held on both engines (POD-6994). The gate's other three boot-wiring files open no store.
beyondStoreShard.apps/server/src/sync/record-sources.test: The record source declarations both engines' change capture is generated from (POD-6982); its four cases that probe SQLite's capture triggers run on SQLite only, the rest on both (POD-6994).
beyondStoreShard.apps/server/src/sync-feed.statement-coun: The sync feed's statement pins (hello, bootstrap and delta, in process and on the sync worker), the same counts on both engines (POD-6989, POD-6991, POD-6994).
beyondStoreShard.apps/server/src/session-create.statement: The session create statement pins (in process and tRPC sessions.create, POD-6983). The in-process pins hold the same counts on both engines; the three tRPC pins run on SQLite only, with the reason in the file (POD-6994).
beyondStoreShard.apps/server/src/sync/record-builders.par: Record builders against the change log they capture, with the capture oracle on: every commit's capture is held against what a row trigger saw (POD-6982, POD-6994).
